## Phantom Stalker (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 N Medium outsider (elemental, extraplanar, fire, shapechanger)  

**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +12  

**Defense**

 **AC** 17, touch 12, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +5 natural)  

**hp** 45 (6d10+12)  

**Fort** +7, **Ref** +7, **Will** +2  

**Defensive Abilities** flames of healing; **Immune** fire, elemental traits  

**Weaknesses** vulnerability to cold  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (average)  

**Melee** 2 burning claws +11 (1d4+4 plus 1d4 fire and grab)  

**Special Attacks** burn, death throes  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 15, **Con** 14, **Int** 4, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 11  

**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +10 (+14 to grapple); **CMD** 22  

**Feats** Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Focus (claw)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (claw).*  

**Skills** Fly +11, Perception +12, Survival +9  

**Languages** Common, Ignan  

**SQ** find target, change shape 1/day (polymorph)  

**Special Abilities**

 **Burn (Ex)** Anyone touching (or touched by) a phantom stalker must succeed on a DC 15 Reflex save or take an extra 1d6 points of fire damage as clothes ignite or armor becomes searing hot. The damage continues for another 1d4+4 rounds after the phantom stalker’s last successful attack. Phantom stalkers can also ignite flammable materials with a touch. The save DC is Constitution-based.  
 **Death Throes (Ex)** A phantom stalker reduced to 0 hit points or less expels a fiery blast equivalent to a fireball (caster level 6th) that deals 6d6 points of fire damage to all creatures within 20 feet. A DC 15 Reflex save reduces the damage by half. The save DC is Constitution-based.
